requirement.original: Sidechain messages are not rendering in the sidebar despite all code being in place
requirement.clarified: Agent/Task subagent child messages do not appear in the tool detail view (sidebar/full-screen). The inline chat shows the Agent tool header but no expandable children. The detail view shows only Description + Input Parameters + Output.
requirement.what: Register TaskViewFull for Agent/Task tools in the full-view registry, and fix CUID2 orphan buffering in the tracer
requirement.why: Users cannot see subagent execution details (tool calls, text output) when clicking on Agent tool calls in the sidebar

included: Tool full-view registry registration for Task/Agent
Verification that inline TaskView renders children

success_criteria: Detail view for Agent tool shows TaskViewFull with expandable Sub Tools section containing child messages
Inline Agent tool card shows sub-tool status rows via TaskView
CUID2-keyed sidechain children are buffered as orphans when parent hasn't arrived yet
constraints: Must not break existing Task tool rendering
Must not break UUID-based orphan buffering for legacy messages

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Sidebar/detail view shows only Description + Input Parameters + Output for Agent tool calls -- no sidechain children visible
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: toolFullViewRegistry in _all.tsx does not include Task or Agent entries. getToolFullViewComponent('Agent') returns null, so ToolFullView.tsx renders the generic layout instead of TaskViewFull which handles children.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - missing registration, not a regression from a specific commit
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: toolFullViewRegistry was created for specialized full-views (MultiEdit) but Task/Agent were only added to the inline toolViewRegistry, not the full-view registry
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Without TaskViewFull in the detail view, the children array is never rendered. The generic ToolFullView only shows tool.description, tool.input, and tool.result.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since the detail/full view feature was implemented

secondary_issue.symptom: CUID2 parentUUID references are not buffered as orphans when parent tool-call hasn't been processed yet
secondary_issue.root_cause: isUuidLike() at reducerTracer.ts:288 returns false for CUID2 strings, causing them to be processed as standalone instead of buffered
secondary_issue.risk_level: Low in normal operation (messages arrive in order), medium during page reload/re-fetch

research_findings.reason: Straightforward UI registration bug with clear root cause from code trace

context.codebase_state: All sidechain protocol code (CLI mapper, app normalizer, tracer, schema) is in place and correct. Only the UI registration and a data-layer edge case are missing.

file_contents._all.tsx:52-54: toolFullViewRegistry only has MultiEdit, missing Task/Agent
file_contents.reducerTracer.ts:117-119: isUuidLike checks UUID v1-v5 pattern, CUID2 does not match
file_contents.reducerTracer.ts:288: !isUuidLike(parentUuid) causes CUID2-keyed children to be standalone

development_approach.strategy: Two-part fix: (1) Add Task/Agent to toolFullViewRegistry mapping to TaskViewFull, (2) Fix isUuidLike gate in tracer to also buffer non-UUID parent references as orphans
development_approach.validation_approach: Build app, deploy to dev web, navigate to a session with Agent tool calls, verify children appear in both inline view and detail/sidebar view. Test with both desktop and mobile viewports.
